sources.snippet: FinBERT sentiment analysis model is now available on Hugging Face model hub. You can get the model here. FinBERT is a pre-trained NLP model to analyze sentiment of financial text. It is built by further training the BERTlanguage model in the finance domain, using a large financial corpus and thereby fine-tuning it for financial sentiment classification.
